turns.text: Hey there! Are you looking for anything specific today, or just browsing?
I am looking for a new jacket for the winter. It is getting very cold lately.
Winter is definitely coming! Do you have a specific style in mind, like a long coat or a puffer jacket?
I think I want puffer jacket because they are very warm. But I'm not sure about the color.

Puffer jackets are a great choice for staying warm! Since you're unsure about the color, do you usually prefer dark tones or something brighter?
💡 I think I want a puffer jacket. (Sayılabilir tekil isimlerden önce 'a' kullanmalısınız.)
I usually like dark colors like navy blue. Kıyafet denemek istiyorum.

Navy blue is a classic and goes with almost everything! The fitting rooms are just around the corner if you're ready.
💡 I want to try on some clothes. (Türkçe yazdığınız ifadenin İngilizcesi budur.)
Thanks! I hope this jacket will fit to me well.

I'm sure it'll look sharp on you! Should I look for a matching scarf while you try that on?
💡 I hope this jacket will fit me well. ('Fit' fiilinden sonra 'to' kullanılmaz.)
That would be great, thank you for your help. Can you find a wool scarf?
I'll go grab a few wool options for you right now. Do you have a favorite color for the scarf, or should I just pick something that matches the jacket?
Hey there! Are you looking for anything special today, or just browsing?
Hi Bloom! I need to buy some new clothes for the summer because my old ones are out of fashion.
Summer clothes shopping is always fun! What kind of items are you hoping to find?
I want to buy a blue denim jacket and few t-shirts.
A denim jacket is a timeless piece and goes with almost everything! Did you find any that you liked so far?
Yes, I tried one yesterday, but it was too small for me. I need look for a larger size today.
Ah, finding the right fit can be tricky sometimes. Did the store assistant help you find your size?
Kabin nerede bulamadım, so I had to leave the shop without trying it.

Ah, finding the fitting room can be a maze in some stores! You can ask someone, "Excuse me, where are the fitting rooms?" 
💡 'Kabin nerede bulamadım' yerine İngilizce'de "I couldn't find where the fitting room was" demelisin, çünkü cümle yapısı düz olmalıdır.
Thanks for the tip! I will definitely ask next time. Do you prefer online shopping or going to malls?
I usually prefer malls because I like to try things on before buying. What about you?
Hey there! I saw a really great movie last night. What kind of films do you usually enjoy watching?
I like science fiction movies because they are very exciting. Last week I have watched a new space film.
Oh cool, sci-fi is always fun! Did you like the special effects in it?
Yes, effects were amazing, but story was a bit boring at the end.
That's a shame when the plot doesn't match the visuals. Who is your favorite actor in these kinds of movies?
En sevdiğim aktör Keanu Reeves çünkü o çok başarılı.
He's awesome, especially in The Matrix! Do you prefer watching movies at the cinema or at home on your laptop?

💡 'En sevdiğim aktör...' yerine İngilizce 'My favorite actor is Keanu Reeves because he is very successful.' demelisin. 

I prefer to watch films at home because cinema tickets are expensive nowadays.
Totally agree, movie tickets cost way too much these days. Do you usually watch them with your friends or alone?
I usually watch movies with my friends in the weekend.
That sounds like a great way to relax. Do you guys ever argue about which movie to pick?

💡 'in the weekend' yerine 'at the weekend' (veya Amerikan İngilizcesi için 'on the weekend') demelisin, çünkü gün ve hafta sonu kalıplarında 'at' veya 'on' kullanılır.

Sometimes we argue, but we always find a funny comedy to watch together.
Hey there! How's it going? Today I'm wondering what kind of healthy habits you try to keep up with during the week.
Hi Bloom! I try to go to gym three times in a week, and I always drink lots of water.
Going to the gym three times a week is a great routine! What's your favorite workout when you're there?
I like running on the treadmill and lift some weights.
Lifting weights and running is a powerful combo! Do you also try to eat healthy, or is that harder for you?
It is hard because I working too much and sometimes I order fast food.
I totally get that, long work days make cooking tough. Do you ever try to meal prep on weekends to save time?
Genellikle hafta sonu dışarıda yemek yiyorum ama belki pazar günleri yemek yapmaya başlayabilirim.
That sounds like a solid plan for next week! What kind of meals would you want to cook first?
Maybe some chicken with vegetables because it is healthy and quick to make.
Chicken and veggies is a classic, healthy choice. Keep it up!
Hey there! How was your weekend? Did you do anything fun?
Hi Bloom! Yes, I went to birthday party of my friend on Saturday.
Oh nice! Whose party was it, and where did you guys go?
It was for my close friend, Melis. We went to a nice cafe in Kadıköy and we ate a lot of chocolate cake.
That sounds delicious! Did you guys stay there the whole evening?
Actually, we have stayed there for three hours, and then we walked by the seaside.
Walking by the seaside sounds so relaxing, especially in Kadıköy! Did you give her a nice gift?
Pastayı çok beğendi ve hediyemi de çok sevdi.
That's awesome! What did you get her in the end?
I bought a silver necklace for her. She wear it immediately!
A silver necklace is such a thoughtful present. Sounds like you had a really great time!
Hey there! The weekend is almost here. Do you have any fun plans for Saturday and Sunday?
Hi Bloom! Yes, I am planning to go to picnic with my friends if the weather will be nice.
A picnic sounds lovely, especially if the sun comes out! Which park are you guys thinking of heading to?
We want to go Emirgan Park because there are lots of tulips right now.
Oh, Emirgan Park is gorgeous this time of year with all those flowers! Are you guys going to bring food from home, or buy something there?
Havayı çok güzel göreceğiz diye düşünüyorum, bu yüzden evden sarma ve börek hazırlayacağız.
Homemade sarma and börek at a park picnic sounds amazing! Who is in charge of making them?
My mom is helping us to prepare everything tomorrow morning. She makes best börek!
Moms always make the best food, don't they? I hope you guys have an awesome time at the park this weekend!
Hey there! How's your week going? Anything interesting happening at your place lately?
Hi Bloom! Actually, I have big problem with my new neighbour. He is very noisy.
Oh no, that's really annoying! What kind of noise is he making, is it loud music?
Yes, listening loud music every night. And he play guitar very late.

That sounds super frustrating when you're trying to sleep. Have you tried talking to him about it yet?
💡 'listening loud music' yerine 'listening to loud music' demelisin, çünkü 'listen' fiili 'to' ile kullanılır. Ayrıca 'he play' yerine 'he plays' olmalı.
No, I didn't spoke to him because I am a little shy.
I totally get that, it can be a bit awkward to knock on a stranger's door. Would you feel more comfortable leaving him a polite note?
Komşuya not yazmak iyi fikir olabilir aslında. What do you think I should write?

That could work really well! You could just write that the walls are thin and ask him to keep the volume down after 10 PM.
💡 'Komşuya not yazmak iyi fikir olabilir' demek için 'Writing a note to the neighbour might be a good idea' diyebilirsin.
Hey! Did you go to any fun parties recently?
Yes, I went to birthday party of my friend last Saturday.
Oh nice! Where was the party held?
It was at his house. We ate pizza and we dance a lot.
That sounds like a lot of fun! What kind of music did you listen to?
Pop müzik dinledik and we sang happy birthday.
Singing happy birthday is always the best part! Did he like his gifts?
Yes, he was very happy for my gift.
That's wonderful! What did you buy him?
I bought a cool red t-shirt for him.
A red t-shirt is a great present! I'm sure he'll wear it all the time.
Hey there! Let's talk about our childhood today. Do you have a special friend from when you were little?
Yes, I have one very good friend in my primary school. Her name is Ayşe.
That's sweet! What did you guys usually do together after classes?
We were playing in the garden and we sharing our secrets.
Playing in the garden sounds like so much fun! Do you still see her nowadays?
Çocukluğumuz bitti ama biz hala görüşüyoruz.
That's wonderful that you're still in touch! Where do you usually meet up now?
We meet at a cafe in the downtown every weekend.
Café hangouts are the best. What is your favorite memory with her?
One day we got lost in the park, and we are very scared.
Oh no, getting lost is scary when you're little! But you made it home safely, I'm sure.
Yes, my mother find us quickly.
Hi! I heard you have a job interview tomorrow. Are you ready for it?
Yes, I am a bit nervous. I want to work in a big company.
It's normal to feel nervous! What kind of job are you applying for?
I applied for the marketing manager position. I worked there for two years.
That's exciting! Can you tell them about your past experience during the interview?
Yes, I can talk about my projects. I am working very hard every day.
That's a great attitude. What will you wear to the interview?
Yarın ne giyeceğimi bilmiyorum.

Don't worry, a nice suit or smart casual clothes are always a safe choice. What do you think you'll wear?
💡
Hey there! I heard you just moved to a new city. How are you liking it so far?
Hi Bloom! Yes, I moved last week. I live in big apartment near the center.
That sounds like a great location! Have you had time to explore your new neighborhood yet?
Yarın markete gitmek istiyorum çünkü evde hiç yemek yok.

I hope you find everything you need at the market! What's the first thing you usually buy when you stock a new kitchen?
💡 'Yarın markete gitmek istiyorum' cümlesini İngilizcede "I want to go to the market tomorrow" şeklinde söyleriz.
I will buy some coffee, pasta and fruits for healthy life.

Good coffee is definitely essential for settling in! Have you met any of your new neighbors yet?
💡 'for healthy life' yerine, 'healthy' kelimesinden önce bir artikel kullanarak "for a healthy life" demeliyiz.
Not yet, but people in street seemed very friendly yesterday.

That's a really good sign, friendly neighbors make a huge difference. What are you most excited to do here this weekend?
💡 'people in street' derken 'street' kelimesinden önce 'the' koymalıyız: "people in the street".
Hi! How was your day at work today?
It was very busy. I go to office at 8 AM and worked hard.
Sounds like you had a long day! What did you do mostly at the office?
I checked many emails and I had three meeting with my boss.
Three meetings with your boss is a lot! Did he give you new projects?
Yes, I must finish a new report until Friday.
You've got a busy week ahead then! Are you tired now?
Evet, çok yorgunum ve şimdi dinlenmek istiyorum.
You definitely deserve to rest now. Grab a cup of tea and relax!
Hey there! I heard you've got a big job interview coming up. How are you feeling about it?
Hi Bloom! I am feel very excited, but also a bit nervous because it is my first interview in English.
It's totally normal to feel that way! Just take a deep breath and remember you've got this. Have you practiced answering some common questions yet?
Yes, I worked on my answers yesterday night. I tried to memorize few examples about my past experience.
Memorizing can help, but try to speak naturally so it doesn't sound too rehearsed. What is the hardest question you think they might ask you?
Zorlukla başa çıkma yeteneğimi sormalarından korkuyorum.
That's a classic question! You can use the STAR method to structure your story clearly. Do you want to try practicing that one right now?
Sure, that sounds like a great idea. Should I give them example from my last job?
Yes, definitely! Specific examples make your story much more convincing. What was a major challenge you faced there?
We had a big deadline last month and our main developer left the team suddenly. I had to take his responsibilities to finish the project on time.
Oh wow, that sounds intense! You handled that pressure really well, and that's exactly the kind of story they want to hear.
Hey there! How's the weather treating you today in your city? It's been so gloomy here lately.
Hi Bloom! Today weather is very nice and sunny, but yesterday was so rainy.
Oh, that's awesome! Sunshine really changes your mood, doesn't it? Did you manage to go outside and enjoy it?
Yes, I went to park for a walk with my friend after the work.
That sounds like a lovely way to spend the afternoon! What kind of weather do you usually prefer for walking?
Hava biraz serin olduğunda yürümeyi daha çok seviyorum.
Walking in cool weather is so refreshing! Do you have a favorite season here, or do you miss the climate back home?
I really love the autumn because trees are very colorful and it is not too hot.
Autumn foliage is definitely gorgeous. Do you usually take photos when the leaves change color?
Yes, I am taking a lot of pictures every October.
That's cool, you must have a great collection of photos by now! Are you hoping for an early winter this year?
Hi there! Do you have any pets at home?
Yes, I have one cat and dog.
Oh nice, cats and dogs are great! What is your cat's name?
My cat name is Pamuk. She is very lazy.
Pamuk is a lovely name! What does she like to do all day?
She sleeping on the sofa every afternoon.
Haha, typical cat behavior! Does she play with toys too?
Bazen top ile oynuyor.
Playing with a ball sounds fun! Is your dog also lazy or very active?
My dog is very young, so he run in the garden all time.
Puppies have so much energy! You must be very busy with him.
Hi there! I love talking about food. What's your favorite thing to cook?
I like cook pasta with tomato sauce.
Yum, pasta is so easy and delicious! Do you make the sauce from scratch?
Yes, I use fresh tomatoes and garlic. Yesterday I cook it for my friends.
That's so nice of you! Did your friends like your pasta?
Yes, they loved it very much. Yemek yapmak benim için çok rahatlatıcı.
Cooking really is a great way to relax! What other dishes can you make?
I can make lentil soup and sometimes I bake a cake in weekend.
Lentil soup is a classic! Do you usually bake chocolate cake or something else?
Hey there! Let's talk about family today. Do you have any brothers or sisters?
Yes, I have one sister and she is doctor in Istanbul.
Oh, a doctor! That's a really demanding job. Does she like working at the hospital?
Yes, she loves her job, but she work very long hours every day.
Long hours can be so exhausting! What do you guys usually do when you get together?
We like eating dinner at home and talk about our week.
That sounds like a lovely tradition. Do you look like your sister, or are you very different?
Bizim gözlerimiz aynı ama o benden daha uzun.
Ah, so you share the same eyes, but she's taller than you! Who is the oldest in your family?
My father is oldest person in our house.
Dads are always special! It sounds like you have a close family.
Hey there! Let's talk about family today. Do you have a big family?
Yes, I have one brother and one sister. We are living together in Ankara with my parents.
That's nice, it must be lively at your house! What do your brother and sister do?
My brother is student at university and my sister works like a accountant.
Oh cool, what does she do as an accountant? Do you guys spend much time together on weekends?
Ailenin birlikte vakit geçirmesi çok önemlidir.
I totally agree with you, family time is so important! What is your favorite thing to do together?
We like watching movies at Sunday evenings and eating popcorn.
That sounds like a cozy tradition! What kind of movies do you usually watch?
Hi there! I heard you want to travel abroad soon. Where are you planning to go?
I want go to Italy next month for see historical places.

Italy is amazing! The food and history there are just incredible. What city do you want to visit first?
💡 "I want to go" (istemek fiilinden sonra 'to' gelir) ve "for see" yerine "to see" (amoch belirtmek için) demeliyiz.
I will go to Rome and maybe Florence. I must buy my ticket in next week.

Rome and Florence are the best choices for a first trip! Are you going with your family or friends?
💡 "in next week" yerine sadece "next week" demeliyiz; "in" editi bu ifadeyle kullanılmaz.
I am going with my best friend. Uçak bileti çok pahalı ama yine de alacağız.

Traveling with a friend is so much fun! Yeah, tickets can be pricey, but it's totally worth it. Have you booked a hotel yet?
💡 "Uçak bileti çok pahalı ama yine de alacağız" demek için İngilizce "The plane ticket is very expensive, but we will buy it anyway" demelisin.
Not yet, we will look hotel tomorrow online.

Good idea, there are many good options online. Make sure to find one near the city center!
💡 "look hotel" yerine "look for a hotel" veya "search for a hotel" demeliyiz.
Hey there! Language learning can be quite a journey. What's been the hardest part for you lately?
Hi Bloom! For me, remembering the new vocabulary is very hard. I am forgetting words easily after I learned them.
Oh, I totally get that! It's super frustrating when words just slip your mind. Have you tried using flashcards or maybe spaced repetition apps?
Yes, I tried apps, but sometimes I studying grammar instead of practice speaking.
Grammar definitely takes up a lot of time, but speaking is where the magic happens! How do you usually practice your speaking skills outside of class?
Konuşacak kimse bulamıyorum, so I usually talk to myself in the room.
Talking to yourself is actually a brilliant trick to get comfortable! What kind of topics do you usually talk about when you're by yourself?
I talk about my day or planning for weekend. It helps me to think in English.
That's a fantastic habit, it really trains your brain to switch languages faster. Do you think planning things out loud helps you feel more confident for real conversations?
Definitely. When I speak with foreigners, I feel much ready now than last year.
That shows your hard work is totally paying off! Is there any specific situation where you still feel nervous speaking English?

💡 "I am forgetting" yerine "I forget" (genel durumlar için geniş zaman) veya "I tend to forget" diyebiliriz.
💡 "I studying grammar instead of practice" yerine "I study grammar instead of practicing" olmalı; prepositions'dan sonra fiil -ing alır.
💡 "Konuşacak kimse bulamıyorum" cümlesini İngilizceye "I can't find anyone to speak with" şeklinde çevirebiliriz.
💡 "much ready" yerine "much readier" veya "a lot more ready" demeliyiz, çünkü 'ready' kelimesinin comparative hali 'readier'dır.
Hey there! I heard you're planning a trip abroad soon. Where are you thinking of going?
Yes, I want to go in England this summer for improve my English.
England is a fantastic choice for practicing your language skills! What kind of places do you want to visit there?
I will visit London museums and I want to see the big clock.
Ah, Big Ben is iconic, you'll love it! Have you booked your hotel yet?
Henüz otel rezervasyonu yapmadım ama hafta sonu bakacağım.
No worries, you still have plenty of time to find a nice place. Will you travel alone or with friends?
I am going with my best friend. We are very excited for this holiday.
Traveling with a good friend makes it so much more fun! What are you most nervous about?
I am afraid for speak English with local people.

Don't worry too much, people are usually very patient with visitors. Just relax and you'll do great!
💡 Say "afraid to speak" or "afraid of speaking" instead of "afraid for speak". Korkmak fiilinden sonra "of" veya "to" kullanılır.
Hi there! What do you like to do in your free time?
I like play football with my friends in the weekends.

That sounds fun! Playing football is a great way to stay active. Do you play in a team or just for fun?
💡 'on the weekends' demelisin, çünkü hafta sonları için 'on' edatını kullanırız.
We play just for fun. Also I am love cooking traditional food.

Cooking is such a relaxing hobby! What is your favorite dish to make?
💡 'I love cooking' demelisin, çünkü 'love' fiili şimdiki zamanla (am love) değil geniş zamanla kullanılır.
Ben en çok mantı yapmayı seviyorum.

Mantí is delicious, though it looks hard to make! Do you make it all by yourself?
💡 'I like making manti the most' diyebilirsin, Türkçe cümle yazdığında İngilizce karşılığı bu şekildedir.
Yes, I make it myself. My mother teach me last year.

That's awesome that she taught you! Will you cook some for your friends soon?
💡 'My mother taught me' demelisin, çünkü 'teach' fiilinin geçmiş zaman hali 'taught'tur.
Hi there! Let's talk about family today. Can you tell me a little bit about your family?
Yes, I have one brother and one sister. My mother is housewife.

That's nice! Having a brother and sister is fun. What does your mother do at home?
💡 "housewife" kelimesinden önce "a" kullanmalısın: "My mother is a housewife."
She cooks dinner and cleans house every day. She is very hardworking.
Sounds like she's really busy! And what about your father? Does he work?
Yes, my father work in a bank. He goes to work on the morning.

Banks are usually busy places! Does he like his job?
💡 Günün saatlerinden önce "on" yerine "in" kullanmalıyız: "in the morning". Ayrıca "father" tekil olduğu için "work" fiiline "-s" takısı gelmeli: "My father works".
Evet, o işini çok seviyor.

That's great that he loves his job! What do you and your siblings like to do together?
💡 İngilizce pratik yapmak için cümleyi şöyle yazabilirsin: "Yes, he loves his job very much."
We play football together weekends and we watch movies.

Playing football and watching movies sounds like a lot of fun! Who usually wins when you play football?
💡 Haftasonları anlamı için "weekends" kelimesinden önce "at" kullanmalısın: "at weekends".
Hi! How are you feeling today? I heard you went to the doctor recently.
Yes, I go to hospital yesterday because I was very sick.

Oh, I'm sorry to hear that! What did the doctor say was wrong with you?
💡 "I went to the hospital" yerine 'yesterday' geçmiş zaman olduğu için 'went' kullanmalıyız ve hastane kelimesinden önce 'the' ekleriz.
Doctor gave me some medicine and said I need rest at home.
At least you have your medicine now. Are you feeling any better today?
Yes, I am better, but my head is still paining a bit.

A headache is the worst. Make sure you drink lots of water and sleep well!
💡 'My head is paining' yerine İngilizcede 'My head hurts' veya 'I have a headache' kalıplarını kullanırız.
Teşekkür ederim, senin tavsiyelerin çok iyi.

You're very welcome! Do you have to go back to the doctor for a check-up next week?
💡 Türkçe yazdığın bu cümleyi İngilizceye "Thank you, your advice is very good." şeklinde çevirebilirsin.
Hey there! What do you usually like to do in your free time?
In my free time, I like playing guitar and read books.

Playing the guitar is so much fun, and reading is great too! What kind of books do you enjoy reading the most?
💡 'read books' yerine 'reading books' demelisin, çünkü 'like' fiilinden sonra gelen fiillere -ing takısı gelir.
I usually read history books. Yesterday I go to a music store for a new guitar string.

History books are super interesting! Did you find the right string for your guitar at the store?
💡 'Yesterday I go' yerine geçmiş zaman olduğu için 'Yesterday I went' demelisin.
Yes, I bought it. Sonra evde yeni teli taktım ve biraz şarkı söyledim.

That sounds like a lovely evening! What song did you play first?
💡 Türkçe yazdığın cümleyi İngilizce söylemek için: 'Then I put the new string on at home and sang a little.' diyebilirsin.
I played my favorite rock song from 90s.

Oh, 90s rock is awesome! Do you play in a band, or is it just for yourself?
💡 'from 90s' yerine önüne 'the' ekleyerek 'from the 90s' demelisin.
It is just for myself, to relax after work.
That's the best way to unwind. Do you want to learn any new instruments next?
Hey there! Do you still keep in touch with any of your friends from childhood?
Yes, I am talking with my best friend from primary school every week.
That's awesome! Maintaining a friendship for that long takes real effort. What kind of things do you guys usually chat about?
We usually talk about old memories and how fast time is passing.
It really does fly by, doesn't it? Have you managed to meet up recently, or do you mostly catch up online?
We couldn't meet for two months because he was very busy with his new job.
Ah, work can definitely get in the way sometimes! Do you think he'll have more free time next month?
Inşallah next month we can grab a coffee together.
I hope so too, I'm sure you both need a good catch-up. Where is your favorite place to hang out when you do see each other?
We always go to a small cafe near the seaside because we love the view.
That sounds like the perfect spot to chill and reminisce. Does he live in the same neighborhood as you now?
Hi there! Let's talk about family today. Can you tell me a little bit about your family?
Yes, I have one brother and one sister. My brother is engineer.

That's nice! Being an engineer is a cool job. Does your brother live in the same city as you?
💡 Mesleklerden önce 'a' veya 'an' kullanmalıyız: 'My brother is an engineer.'
No, he live in Ankara. He works in a big office.

Ah, Ankara is a big city! How often do you visit him?
💡 Geniş zamanda 'he' öznesinden sonra fiile '-s' takısı gelmelidir: 'he lives'.
I go to Ankara every summer for see my family.

Summer visits are always fun! What do you usually do together when you are there?
💡 'Amacıyla' anlamı katmak için 'for see' yerine 'to see' demeliyiz: 'to see my family'.
Biz bütün aile bir araya geliyoruz ve yemek yiyoruz.

That sounds delicious and so warm! Family dinners are the best.
💡 Bu cümleyi İngilizce söylemek için: 'All our family comes together and we eat dinner.'
Hey there! What do you usually like to do in your free time?
Hi Bloom! In my free time, I am playing guitar and sometimes I go to cinema with my friends.

Playing the guitar sounds like a lot of fun! What kind of music do you like to play on it?
💡 Hobilerden bahsettiğimiz için geniş zaman kullanmalıyız: "I play guitar" demelisin. Ayrıca sinemaya gitmek için "go to the cinema" daha doğal olur.
I usually play rock music because it is very energizing for me.
Rock music is awesome for getting energized! Are you in a band, or do you just play for yourself at home?
No band yet, I just playing in my room. Zaten pek iyi çalamıyorum.

Practice makes perfect, so don't worry about it! Have you ever tried writing your own songs?
💡 Türkçe yazdığın cümleyi İngilizce söylemek için: "I can't play very well yet."
Not yet, but I want try it in the future.

That's a cool goal to have. What kind of song topics would you write about if you started today?
💡 "Want" fiilinden sonra diğer fiili kullanırken "to" eklemeliyiz: "want to try" demelisin.
Probably about city life and nature. Thanks for chatting with me!
Hi there! How are you feeling today? I remember you weren't feeling well yesterday.
Hi Bloom. I am go to the doctor yesterday because I have terrible headache.

Oh no, a terrible headache sounds awful! Did the doctor give you any medicine to help?
💡 Yesterday kelimesi geçmiş zaman gerektirir; bu yüzden "I went" demelisin. Ayrıca "have" fiili de geçmişte "had" olur: "I went to the doctor yesterday because I had a terrible headache."
Yes, she prescribed me some pills and told me to rest at home for two days.
That sounds like good advice. Are you feeling any better now after taking the medicine?
A little bit better, but I must to drink a lot of water now.

Drinking water is definitely a good idea! Do you need to go back to the hospital next week?
